# Official, public-domain SQLite source. No network access during configuration.
set(sqlite_archive "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/sqlite-amalgamation-3540100.zip")
file(SHA3_256 "${sqlite_archive}" sqlite_hash)
if(NOT sqlite_hash STREQUAL "92281c86e2957f9b9305890f9ac04204caa7b677cc868dc326d942689df28e30")
    message(FATAL_ERROR "Bundled SQLite source archive checksum mismatch")
endif()
file(ARCHIVE_EXTRACT INPUT "${sqlite_archive}" DESTINATION "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}")
set(sqlite_source "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/sqlite-amalgamation-3540100")
add_library(linaccess_sqlite SHARED "${sqlite_source}/sqlite3.c")
set_target_properties(linaccess_sqlite PROPERTIES OUTPUT_NAME sqlite3 SOVERSION 0 AUTOMOC OFF)
target_compile_definitions(linaccess_sqlite PRIVATE SQLITE_ENABLE_COLUMN_METADATA SQLITE_THREADSAFE=1)
target_include_directories(linaccess_sqlite PUBLIC "${sqlite_source}")
find_package(Threads REQUIRED)
target_link_libraries(linaccess_sqlite PRIVATE Threads::Threads ${CMAKE_DL_LIBS} m)
install(TARGETS linaccess_sqlite LIBRARY DESTINATION lib/linaccess NAMELINK_SKIP)
install(FILES README.md DESTINATION share/doc/linaccess RENAME sqlite.txt)
